title: Full Stack Developer co-op
description:
About Flexspring

Everything connects. That's not just our tagline - it's the whole job.
Flexspring is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) built for one of the thornier problems in enterprise software: getting HR systems to actually talk to each other. We link payroll, recruiting, benefits, and HRIS platforms API-to-API so data moves between them cleanly and in near real-time, with no manual re-entry anywhere. The results back it up - 3,000+ integrations delivered, 800+ clients including Fortune 500 companies, ADP Marketplace Platinum Partner, and named HR Data Integration Experts of the Year 2025. And we do it all as a remote-first team spread across Canada and beyond.
The Opportunity
We're looking for a Full Stack Software Developer Co-op to join our R&D team - and we'll be upfront about what that means.
This is real experience, in the fullest sense. No throwaway side project, no busywork to fill the term - from your first weeks you'll work on our actual product, as a real part of the team, shipping features that real customers depend on. Many of our co-ops go on to join us full-time after graduation.
You'll work mainly in a Java-based stack, and you'll quickly find that integration work is half code, half business reasoning - every feature exists because a real company needs its HR data to move without breaking. If you like building things that ship, and you tend to ask "what is this really for?" before writing a line of code, we'd love to hear from you.
What You'll Be Working On

• Building and improving features in Flexspring 's product - and understanding the customer problem each one solves

• Writing backend and full stack code in Java and JavaScript

• Working with APIs and the data flowing between HR systems, where getting the small details right is the whole job

• Using modern tooling, AI included, to work efficiently - and reviewing what it produces with a careful eye before it ships

• Writing and running tests so you know your work holds up before it reaches a customer

• Collaborating with experienced developers through code reviews and team discussions

What We're Looking For

• Strong analytical thinking. You like connecting the work in front of you to the reason it matters - the why, the outcome, the customer on the other end. Seeing the full picture is more satisfying to you than just closing a ticket.

• A thoughtful approach to new tools. You enjoy picking up unfamiliar technology, including AI tools, and using it to work faster and smarter. You also know that generating output is only the start - the real value is in reviewing it, catching what's off, and being able to stand behind the result.

• You've already completed minimum one co-op term or have some relevant professional work experience - this won't be your first time in a real work environment

• You're currently studying Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

• A solid foundation in Java and JavaScript

• Some exposure to Spring and JUnit (school projects absolutely count)

• You've worked with or learned about APIs

• You're curious, motivated, and enjoy getting to the bottom of a problem

Nice to Haves

• Experience with REST APIs, React, GraphQL, Groovy, JMS, or SOAP

• Interest in integration platforms (iPaaS) and how systems connect

• Curiosity about how large systems talk to each other - and what happens when they don't

What You'll Walk Away With

• Real, hands-on experience shipping to a production platform that real customers rely on

• Mentorship from senior developers who'll invest in how you think, not just the code you write

• A working understanding of how HR data actually moves between enterprise systems

• Real practice using AI and modern dev tooling the way strong engineers do - fast, but with judgment

• Competitive co-op pay

• Flexible hours in a remote-first environment

• A strong chance to grow into a full-time role after graduation

title: Senior Agentic Identity Security Manager
description:
We Are

Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond, and recover along with all points of the security lifecycle. Cybersecurity challenges are different for every business in every industry. Leveraging our global resources and advanced technologies, we create integrated, turnkey solutions tailored to our client's needs across their entire value chain. Whether we’re defending against known cyberattacks, detecting and responding to the unknown, or running an entire security operations center, we will help companies build cyber resilience to grow with confidence. Our team of the security sector’s brightest people uses the coolest tech to out-hack the hackers and help clients build resilience from within. We blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security, and managed service solutions to rethink the entire security lifecycle.

Do you have the deep functional and technical experience to help implement security solutions that align with our clients’ business objectives? Do you have the expertise to design and deliver solutions for establishing system user's credentials, and processes for applying those credentials to access enterprise systems and applications?

If so, read on and apply. Accenture ’s more than 2,000 security professionals deliver holistic and proactive security solutions in 47 countries, and we’d love to discuss our open Identity and Access Management (I&AM) Security role with you

You Are

An engineer who moved into leadership without losing the technical depth that got you there. You've been senior long enough to set direction, and you can still follow the implementation when it matters. You're resourceful about how you get there. You know which problems call for a library, which call for a vendor product, and which call for writing the thing yourself, and you've been wrong about that split enough times to have earned opinions about it. You read the spec instead of guessing what it says. You've debugged something at 2am because you wanted to know why it broke, not because anyone asked.

You've shipped systems that other engineers depended on and that you were accountable for when they failed. You've made architecture decisions that turned out badly, watched the consequences play out, and can describe what you'd do differently. You've reviewed enough code to know the difference between a style disagreement and a real problem.

You can explain a hard technical idea to a CISO without condescending or hiding behind jargon, and you can hold your own in a design review with engineers who know more than you do about their piece of it. You'll tell a client no when the thing they asked for is the wrong thing, and you'll have a defensible alternative ready.

You almost certainly haven't done this specific work before. Very few people have, which is most of why it's interesting.

The Work

This Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic Identity Platform is a technical leadership role. You will not necessarily be writing code day to day, and on many engagements you won't be. What you will do is read it, review it, and make design calls that depend on understanding how the system actually works rather than how it was described in a deck. When a service fails or a design is wrong, you should be able to go look for yourself.

We are not hiring a delivery manager who signs off on technical work. We are hiring someone with real engineering depth who is senior enough to set direction.

Enterprises are deploying AI agents faster than anyone has figured out how to secure them. An agent authenticates to twelve systems, spawns subagents, calls tools on behalf of a user who left the company last month, and holds credentials nobody inventoried. The identity primitives that industry spent twenty years building for humans and service accounts don't cleanly extend to actors that are autonomous, ephemeral, and delegating authority to each other.

IRCA is a prominent international provider of semi-finished ingredients for the bakery, pastry, and gelato markets. They cater to independent producers as well as large food manufacturers, including consumer packaged goods (CPG) companies. The company's core product offerings consist of chocolate, chocolate decorations, creams, pastry mixes, gelato ingredients, and various other bakery and pastry ingredients.
 
Headquartered in Italy, IRCA was acquired by Advent International, a global private equity firm, in July 2022. The company has demonstrated a strong history of growth over the past decade. As part of its growth strategy, IRCA made two bolt-on acquisitions in 2022. They acquired Cesarin, a provider of candied fruits, and Anastasi, a supplier of pistachio ingredients. These acquisitions expanded IRCA's product portfolio and market reach.
 
More recently, IRCA acquired the leading manufacturer of sweet and cereal products in Europe and the US. The target company focuses on high-value specialty ingredients for the Food Manufacturers segment. Their product range includes sweet particulates, chocolate confections, baked inclusions, variegates, and fruit purées. This deal, successfully completed in March of 2023, is a transformative move for IRCA, establishing them as a global leader in the semi-finished ingredients industry.
 
With this acquisition, IRCA has a combined revenue of €1 billion in 2023 and a presence in 22 manufacturing facilities across Europe, the US, and Vietnam. This expanded manufacturing footprint and diversified product portfolio positions IRCA as a key player in the market, serving a wide range of customers in the bakery, pastry, and gelato sectors, as well as food manufacturers.

title: Feature Engineer (AI-native)
description:
The Mission

Voyagu is a travel operations platform , a large product that powers travel agencies end to end - trip economics, sales, ticketing, accounting and marketing - with a wide range of integrations with GDS and external services (payments, email, calls/SMS and more). Many kinds of users work inside it, from agents and searchers to back-office teams, and the agencies’ own clients interact with the platform through a separate web interface.

We're hiring a Feature Engineer, who owns features end to end and drives an AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) as a daily engineering tool.

The Bet We're Making

We bet on speed of thinking and quality of work with an agent , not years of stack. We want an engineer who, with an AI agent, ships like a stronger engineer - because they lead the agent instead of clicking "accept."

You write a plan, break work into steps, verify each step, reason about the output, and give precise next instructions. You don't trust code you haven't verified. If your style is "generate it and click around the UI until it seems to work," this isn't for you - and vice versa.

You Care Why, Not Just How

You engage with the business problem, not just the ticket. You don't need to know travel - the domain is specific and nobody arrives knowing it. What matters is that you get curious about why a feature exists, who needs it, and what changes once it ships. When a business stakeholder comes to you, that conversation is interesting, not an interruption. That habit is a large part of what we're selecting for.

Tech Stack

•
Backend: Python (SQLAlchemy, GraphQL, PostgreSQL) - complex queries against a rich data model. Writing complex SQL itself is something an agent helps with. The judgment around it is on you.

•
Frontend: Angular - kept deliberately thin, with help available for the harder parts. You don’t need to be a frontend expert, just the kind of person who says “I’ll take the feature,” not “that’s not my layer.”

•
Agent: Claude Code / Cursor / Codex as a normal, daily tool (your choice of agent).

What You'll Do

• Own features end to end across the platform: economics, sales, ticketing, integrations and more.

• Build services in Python (SQLAlchemy, GraphQL, PostgreSQL) with correct transactional behavior.

• Integrate external systems: GDS, payments, email, calls/SMS and other services.

• Ship the full slice of a feature, including the Angular frontend when it needs it.

• Work with an AI agent daily - plan, steps, verification - owning quality, not volume of generated lines.

• Grow scope fast as the team and responsibilities expand.

What We're Looking For

• Solid backend development experience in Python .

• Strong understanding of database transactions and data correctness; comfortable with complex queries (mandatory) .

• Real, daily experience working with an AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar) - a requirement, not a plus .

• A disciplined process: planning, step-by-step work, verifying your own code.

• Genuine interest in the business behind the code - you can explain what problem a feature solved and who it served.

• Willingness and ability to work across the stack, including frontend. You own features, not layers.

• English B2+ (working level).

Why Voyagu

• A large, real product - a travel operations platform with many domains, so you get variety and depth, not one narrow corner.

• An AI-first engineering culture: the agent is the norm, not a banned tool.

• Fast-growing responsibility for people who deliver.

• Fully remote, start ASAP.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Multi-Cloud Architect to design strategies, reference architectures, and platform capabilities that span multiple cloud providers - AWS, Azure, GCP, and selectively OCI - for enterprises operating on more than one cloud by deliberate choice. The role focuses on portability, abstraction layers, federated identity, cross-cloud networking, and platform offerings that hide cloud-specific complexity from product teams. The ideal candidate has architected meaningful multi-cloud capabilities, understands the trade-offs between portability and cloud-native depth, and brings strong opinions grounded in production experience.

• Architect cross-cloud networking including transit hubs, private connectivity, and zero-trust patterns.

• Establish reusable infrastructure-as-code patterns that abstract cloud-specific implementations where appropriate.

• Define container, Kubernetes, and serverless strategies that work consistently across providers.

• Design data architecture strategies for cross-cloud data movement, residency, and analytics.

• Produce high-quality architecture artifacts - context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs - that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.

• Engage with cloud providers and partners to evaluate roadmap alignment.

• Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security across multiple providers.

• Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code across clouds.

• Experience designing federated identity and SSO across cloud platforms.

• Solid understanding of Kubernetes, container platforms, and managed cloud services.

• Multiple cloud certifications across providers.

• Track record of leading multi-cloud architecture initiatives.

title: Freelance Pitch Form
description:
ProPublica is an independent, nonprofit newsroom that produces investigative journalism in the public interest.

While the vast majority of ProPublica ’s work comes from our staff, we occasionally consider supporting ambitious accountability stories or projects from independent journalists whose ideas align with the mission of our organization.

Here’s what journalists submitting proposals should know.

We’re open to investigations that are revelatory or substantially advance what is known on a subject of importance. The investigation should have the potential to trigger needed reforms by identifying a problem, who’s responsible and what should change. It should also clearly show harm. The investigation can be rooted in a place or focus on a person, but it should illuminate an issue of broader relevance.

The best proposals have a clear hypothesis, typically based on significant reporting: They don’t wonder whether something bad is happening, they know it. Please include not only a general description of the topic, but also a sense of the anecdotes/data/documents you have gathered, what you expect to find and possible accountability stories you want to tell.
In addition, applicants should detail, as much as is possible at the outset, what an investigation will require: data work, travel, obtaining public records. It’s also important for us to know what data, documents and/or source relationships the reporter already has. Finally, we’d like to hear a bit about why you are particularly suited to do this investigation.

We will begin reviewing applications as we receive them, and aim to notify candidates regarding your proposals within two weeks of submission. Questions? Send an email to . No phone calls, please.
For those proposals we accept, we pay competitive freelance rates, including reporting expenses. Freelancers are independent contractors and will not be treated by ProPublica as employees for any purpose.
Independent contractors are responsible for paying any required taxes on any compensation received and for understanding the applicable tax laws. We will begin reviewing applications as we receive them, and aim to notify candidates regarding your proposals within two weeks of submission.

We know there are great candidates who may not fit into what we’ve described above or who have important skills we haven’t thought of. If that’s you, don’t hesitate to apply and tell us about yourself.

We are dedicated to improving our newsroom, in part by better reflecting the people we cover. (Here is a breakdown of our staff.) We are committed to diversity and building an inclusive environment for people of all backgrounds and ages. And we are taking steps to meet that commitment. We especially encourage members of traditionally underrepresented communities to apply, including women, people of color, LGBTQ+ people and people with disabilities. We are an equal opportunity employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age or any other status protected under applicable law.

We are seeking an experienced Civil Engineer / Project Manager to lead the planning, design, permitting, and execution of civil engineering and land development projects from concept through construction. This individual will serve as the primary point of contact for clients while managing multidisciplinary project teams to successfully deliver commercial, residential, industrial, institutional, and mixed-use developments.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for project quality, financial performance, client satisfaction, schedule management, and team development while contributing to business growth and long-term client relationships.
Key Responsibilities Project Management & Client Relations Serve as the primary client contact for assigned projects. Manage multiple projects simultaneously from due diligence through construction completion. Develop project scopes, budgets, schedules, and work plans. Monitor project performance, including labor utilization, invoicing, profitability, and overall financial health. Lead meetings with clients, contractors, municipalities, regulatory agencies, and consultants. Ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and aligned with client expectations. Identify project risks and develop proactive mitigation strategies. description:

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We're intentional, we're unapologetically curious and we're 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

As a member of our team, you will play a crucial role in driving our success. Our team members have a strong sense of dedication and responsibility; this includes a strong commitment to our mission to create an entirely new suite of global capabilities to improve lives, business efficiencies and build a smarter planet. title: Auto Physical Damage Specialist
description:
Job Summary:

The Physical Damage Specialist is responsible for investigating, evaluating, negotiating, and resolving first-party automobile physical damage claims. This role requires expertise in vehicle damage assessment, repair estimation, and claim settlement practices while delivering exceptional customer service and maintaining compliance with company guidelines and regulatory requirements.

This is a remote position with occasional visits to our New York office as needed.

Salary range: $65,000 - $75,000

What you will do:

• Investigate and manage first-party auto physical damage claims from initial report through final resolution.

• Review coverage, determine liability as applicable, and evaluate damages in accordance with policy provisions.

• Review damaged vehicles through virtual, and/or photo-based appraisal methods.

• Review repair estimates using industry-standard estimating platforms.

• Negotiate repair costs and claim settlements with body shops, policyholders, claimants, and vendors.

• Identify potential fraud indicators and escalate concerns as appropriate.

• Coordinate inspections, salvage disposition, and total loss evaluations.

• Maintain timely and accurate claim documentation in the claim management system.

• Ensure compliance with state regulations including New York’s Regulation 64, company policies, and claims handling standards.

• Provide clear, professional communication to policyholders and business partners throughout the claim process.

• Manage claim inventory to ensure service, quality, and productivity expectations are met.

What you will bring:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.

• Minimum of 3 years of property damage and/or first-party auto claims adjusting experience.

• Demonstrated experience in vehicle damage appraisal and repair estimating.

• Knowledge of automobile construction, repair techniques, and collision damage assessment.

• Experience utilizing industry-standard estimating software (CCC One, Mitchell, Audatex, or similar).

• Strong investigative, negotiation, and customer service skills.

• Ability to manage a high-volume claim workload while meeting established deadlines.

Preferred:

• Auto Damage Appraiser License a plus.

• I-CAR, ASE, or other industry-related certifications.

• Prior experience handling total loss evaluations and salvage processes.

• Multi-state claims handling experience.

• New York Adjuster License

What we offer:

• Comprehensive health benefits

• Life and disability insurance

• 401(k) with company match

• Paid parental leave

• Paid vacation, sick time, holidays, and birthday

• Peer recognition program

Kingstone Core Values:

• We roll up our sleeves

• We take ownership for Kingstone's success

• We are nimble and move fast

• You are not a number

title: Principal Conversational & Agentic AI Architect
description:
When you join Verizon
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely - even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love - driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together - lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
What you’ll be doing...
We are seeking a highly skilled Conversational & Agentic AI Architect to design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade conversational AI and multi-agent solutions within a Consulting organization. This role demands hands-on technical architecture, a product-led engineering mindset, and extensive expertise in both speech science and Generative AI. You will be responsible for consulting with customers to create seamless, multi-turn conversational experiences that move beyond rigid decision trees into dynamic, agentic interactions, successfully integrating complex backend systems while managing both sophisticated NLU models and LLMs.
Key Responsibilities

• Agentic & Conversational Architecture: Architect and maintain complex conversational flows, transitioning from traditional State-Based Flows and event handlers to modern Generative AI and multi-agent orchestrated solutions (e.g., Dialogflow Playbooks, Vertex AI , or Microsoft Copilot Studio).

• LLM Engineering & NLU Design: Manage complex intent taxonomies capable of handling 200+ unique intents without overlapping, ensuring high Intent Precision & Recall while minimizing False Positives. Lead efforts in LLM fine-tuning, prompt engineering, distillation, and evaluating small/efficient models for latency-sensitive voice applications.

• Collision Analysis & Tuning: Conduct regular conflict detection and ambiguity testing to resolve intents that compete for the same user phrases, while securing AI models against prompt manipulation and data vulnerabilities.

• STT, STS & Multi-Modal Extraction: Tune Speech-to-Text (STT) and Speech-to-Speech adaptations and hints to improve recognition for industry-specific jargon, and design complex custom entities to extract critical data from unstructured speech and generative interactions.

• System Integration & Backend: Build and deploy robust webhooks and serverless backend services using Node.js or Python to connect virtual agents with third-party APIs, CRMs, and databases. Implement model serving infrastructure and scalable cross-platform AI solutions.

• Performance Benchmarking & ROI: Build "Golden Sets" for automated regression testing to measure F1-scores across model versions, and use tools like BigQuery to analyze real-world "No-Match" logs. Conduct Return-on-Investment (ROI) analysis of AI-powered solutions and interpret telemetry data to drive continuous product improvement.

What we’re looking for...
You’ll need to have:

• Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.

• Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.

• Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks such as Python, JavaScript, Java, Next JS, Node.js, React js Strong working experience with GenAI, LLM Models, MCP, Vector DB, RAG, Vertex AI, Agentic AI frameworks like NGA, ADK or LangChain/LangGraph, creating AI agents.

• Experience with Cloud platforms like GCP, Azure or AWS and cloud technologies like OpenStack, Terraform, Ansible or Chef

• Experience working with LLM observability, analytics, evaluations, testing and annotation using tools like LangSmith, LangFuse, Streamlit, Arize or similar tools.

• Experience working with AI/ML development.

• Willingness to travel 25%

description:
Job Title: In-Home Health - Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant (Part Time) - Bronx,
Job Location: Work at Home, New York, United States
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Part time
Job Seniority Level:
We’re building a world of health around every individual - shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

• Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home health clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of our members. We are dedicated to providing care wherever our members call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke, and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA
“At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP
“I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

Part-time employees qualify for:

• Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

• Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

• Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (NPs and PAs)

• Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

• Board certification (required)

• Multi-state licenses (preferred)

• Able to cover the following primary locations: Bronx, New York and surrounding area.
